title: The First Aircraft to Ever Fly on Mars
description: NASA's Ingenuity helicopter made history by completing the first powered flight on another planet. Filmed by the Perseverance rover, it completed dozens of flights across the Martian surface.

shots.narration: This is the first aircraft ever to fly on another planet, captured by the Perseverance rover.
Here sits Ingenuity on the Martian surface, weighing one point eight kilograms with a one point two metre rotor span.
Mars air is about one percent as dense as Earth's air at sea level.
To produce lift in this thin atmosphere, its twin rotors must spin at around two thousand four hundred rpm.
On nineteen April 2021, it made a three-metre hover lasting about thirty-nine seconds.
Its navigation camera tracked the surface as it later reached thirty-six kilometres per hour and climbed to twenty-four metres.
Engineers designed it for five test flights in thirty days, but it flew seventy-two flights over almost three years.
Across all those flights above the red planet, the small craft covered more than seventeen kilometres.
The mission ended in January 2024 when a rotor blade was damaged on landing.
